output.subject: Your request to update your address and replacement card delivery
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch with us through our web form.

You asked us to change the address we hold for you from your old address to your new one. You also mentioned that you want your replacement debit card sent to the new address, because you don't want it sitting at the old place. We understand why that matters to you, and we appreciate you letting us know before the card goes out.

We have passed your message to our Card Services team, who will review both your address change request and your request about where your replacement debit card is sent. They will respond to you within 10 business days, and if they need anything further from you to complete your request, they will let you know.

If anything changes in the meantime, or if you have any other questions, please reply to this message and we will add it to your request.

Thank you again for reaching out to us.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a service request, not a complaint; the reply treats it as a request.
The draft does not confirm the address has been changed; confirm whether the update can be made and tell the customer if so.
Check whether the replacement debit card has already been dispatched to the old address and decide what to tell the customer if it has.
Verify the customer's identity per standard procedure before making any address change.
The old and new addresses were left out of the draft on purpose; add them only if appropriate.
The 10-business-day timeframe may be too slow for card delivery; consider whether faster action or contact is needed.
